paite: Leitung luah tengteng aw, Pathian pahtawi in nuam in kikou unla.
heading: Lapu Lian A Ding. Phatna La / Israel Tung A Pathian Hoihna Phatna
english: For the Chief Musician. A song. A Psalm. Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!

paite: Amin thupidan la in sa unla, aphatna hih thupi un.
english: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!

paite: Pathian kiang ah, "Na thilhihte mulkimhuai na e! Na thilhihtheihna thupidan thu ah nangmah melmate na kiang ah akipelut ding uhi.
english: Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.

paite: Leitung luah tengteng in ahon be ding ua, nangmah phat in la asa ding uh, chi un. Selah
english: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.” Selah.

paite: Kisa un, Pathian thilhihte en un; mihing tate tung a athilhih ah akihtakhuai ahi.
english: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.

paite: Ama'n tuipi leigaw asuaksak a; luipi khe in apaikai ua, huai ah amah ah i kipak uhi.
english: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.

paite: Athilhihtheihna in tangtawn in vai ahawm hi; amit in namte a-en hi, helhatte kipahtawi kei uhen. Selah
english: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.

paite: Michihte aw, i Pathian uh phat unla, amah phatna husa theisak un.
english: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,

paite: Ama'n i hinna uh ahihhing gige a, I khete kisuan aphal kei hi.
english: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.

paite: Pathian aw, nang na hon enchian a; dangkasik etchet bang in na hon enchian hi.
english: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.

paite: Nang len ah na hon pilut a; ka kawng uah puakgik giktak na hon koih hi.
english: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.

paite: Mihingte, kangtalai tung a tuang in, ka lutung uah na paisak a; meikuang leh tui ah ka paisuak ua; himahleh mun hausatak ah lut ding in na hon pikhia ahi.
english: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.

paite: Halmang thillatte toh na inn ah ka lut ding a, ka thuchiamte na lak ah ka tangtungsak ding hi.
english: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,

paite: Ka muk in agen a, mangbang a ka om lai a kam in agente mah.
english: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.

paite: Sathautak halmang thillatte na kiang ah ka lan ding a, belampate hal namtui toh; bawngtalte, kelte toh ka lan ding hi. Selah
english: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.

paite: Kisa un, Pathian laudan siam tengteng aw, ngaikhia un. Huchi in ka hinna a ding a athilhih ka hon theisak ding hi.
english: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.

paite: Ka kam in amah ka sam a, ka lei a pahtawi in a-om hi.
english: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.

paite: Ka lungtang a thulim lou ka limsakleh Toupa'n hon ngaikhe kei ding hi.
english: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.

paite: Himahleh, Pathian in hon ngaikhia a; ka thumna alimsak hi.
english: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.

paite: Pathian aw, ka thumna vuaksuaksak lou a, ka lak a azahngaihna tawp sam lou phat in om hen.
english: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.
